GTNPCMULTIATTACK.Presets.ChargeDescripti: When enabled, limit the batch to one attack and deal three times the base damage on a hit.
GTNPCMULTIATTACK.Presets.AmbushDescripti: When enabled, roll one additional base damage die on a hit.
GTNPCMULTIATTACK.Presets.BackstabDescrip: When enabled, deal twice the base damage on a hit.

GTNPCMULTIATTACK.Presets.AlgaeEaterDescr: When enabled, every attack in the batch is made with advantage, and the attacker takes 1d4 damage before each one.
GTNPCMULTIATTACK.Presets.ShatterDescript: When enabled, destroys one random piece of nonmagical gear on the target instead of dealing damage — equipped or carried, but never magic items, scrolls, potions, wands, gems or treasure. A stack of N loses 1dN. The ruined gear is copied onto this creature and noted in its description. Normal damage if nothing qualifies.
GTNPCMULTIATTACK.Presets.MobDescription: When enabled, deal +1 damage while beside an ally.
GTNPCMULTIATTACK.Presets.PodHunterDescri: When enabled, deal +2 damage while an ally is within near.
GTNPCMULTIATTACK.Presets.SwallowDescript: After a hit, the target makes a DC 12 STR check or becomes swallowed and suffers 1d8 damage on later turns.
GTNPCMULTIATTACK.Presets.GrabDescription: After a hit, steal one random item from the target's carried gear or gems. Equipped and stashed items are safe. Player characters only.
GTNPCMULTIATTACK.Presets.RageDescription: While injured, replace d6 damage dice with d8s.
GTNPCMULTIATTACK.Presets.GreedyDescripti: When enabled, instead of dealing damage, opens a GM window listing everything the target carries — gear, gems and coins. The GM highlights plausible loot and one entry is chosen at random. The item is copied onto this creature and into the Items directory under a grey "Stolen" folder; coins are only noted in the creature's description. Player characters only. If the target carries nothing, normal damage is dealt.
GTNPCMULTIATTACK.Inventory.TheftHint: Highlight anything {attacker} could plausibly grab. One highlighted entry is chosen at random. A coin entry yields 1d100 coins, at most what is held. The stolen item is copied onto the creature and into the Items directory under a grey "Stolen" folder.

GTNPCMULTIATTACK.Presets.SeverDescriptio: On a successful natural attack roll of 18 or higher, roll 1d6 to sever a random limb: 1 head, 2–4 arm, 5–6 leg.
GTNPCMULTIATTACK.Presets.PoisonDescripti: On a hit, the target makes a CON check or takes 1d4 damage. Every hit is a fresh check. Set the DC and damage on the attack.
GTNPCMULTIATTACK.Presets.PoisonParalyzeD: On a hit, the target makes a CON check or is paralyzed for 1d4 rounds. Shadowdark's Toxin, Poison and Paralyze features all use this shape; set the DC and duration on the attack.
GTNPCMULTIATTACK.Presets.PoisonSleepDesc: On a hit, the target makes a CON check or falls asleep for 1d8 hours. Hour-long durations are recorded on the effect but not expired automatically; clear it when it ends.
GTNPCMULTIATTACK.Presets.PoisonLethalDes: On a hit, the target makes a CON check or drops to 0 HP. Add a death timer on the attack for the harsher variants.
GTNPCMULTIATTACK.Presets.PetrifyDescript: On a hit, the target makes a CON check or is petrified. Tick "Random limb only" on the attack for creatures that petrify a single limb.
GTNPCMULTIATTACK.Presets.KnockDescriptio: On a hit, the target makes a STR check or is knocked prone and pushed a close distance. The push is reported for the GM to apply; tokens are never moved automatically.
GTNPCMULTIATTACK.Presets.KnockNote: Pushed a close distance and knocked down.
GTNPCMULTIATTACK.Presets.AbilityDrainDes: On a hit, the target loses ability score points with no check — Drain (WIS) and Life Drain (CON) in Shadowdark. Set the ability and dice on the attack, and use the note for what happens at 0.
